label: GitGuardian SaaS platform release notes
note: Product and feature announcements, about one a week (13 from 2026-09-07 to 2026-11-20). Self-Hosted mostly repeats these monthly and ggshield posts are CLI version bumps, so neither is watched. Detector releases are tracked in Detector Atlas, not here.

label: GitHub Changelog: application security label
note: Security-scoped slice of GitHub's changelog: secret scanning, code scanning, CodeQL and Advanced Security. About 10 posts in three weeks (2026-11-04 to 2026-11-23). The full changelog is not watched because it covers every GitHub product.

label: GitLab release notes and patch releases
note: Monthly release notes plus roughly weekly patch releases (8 posts from 2026-10-15 to 2026-11-20). Patch releases are usually dismissed; the monthly notes cover secret detection and other security features. Large feed (about 4 MB).

label: HashiCorp blog: Vault
note: Vault-only slice of HashiCorp's blog, where Vault, Vault Radar and HCP launches are announced. About 8 posts from 2026-10-22 to 2026-11-17.

label: Doppler changelog
note: One roll-up post per month listing that month's product changes.

label: Aikido Security blog
note: Aikido announces launches on its blog, which also carries vulnerability write-ups and articles. High volume (several posts a week); most items will be dismissed.

label: Snyk blog
note: Product announcements, analyst news and articles. About one to three posts a week.

label: Wiz blog
note: Product announcements, research and articles; linked from wiz.io as its RSS feed. Several posts a week; most items will be dismissed.

label: Aembit blog
note: Workload and agent identity vendor. The feed lists only the newest few posts, so a busy week could drop items between weekly runs.

label: Cycode blog
note: Product announcements, vulnerability write-ups and research. Several posts a week.

label: OX Security blog
note: The feed lists only the newest post, so weekly runs can miss posts in busy weeks. Watched anyway as the only official feed OX publishes.
